# `AutoFocus`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Autofocus progress and result, from the function detail and the direct V-curve callback.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, AutoFocusFunc @0x26e240, CbTellVCurveParameter @0x26cd00, PrintAfInfo @0x2694a0 (64-bit build) |

Sent by AutoFocusFunc (F, formatter adds center_xy) and by the direct/value producer fed from the V-curve callback (start, working, complete, fail; result embedded as JSON; position; error/code on failure). Function-state family (F): SendFuncEvent formats the named function detail. state is always present; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms while the timer runs or at a terminal state; error and code at fail (even when the stored code is zero; lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'); cancel omits code and error; route is optional function ancestry. The sender does no deduplication and needs no preceding working event. Detail flags can suppress the working or non-working sends while the cached function tree still changes, so a receiver can miss transitions. Cadence depends on focus steps and exposures. The V-curve members and last_point shape are READ; what separates status_flag 2 from 3 is unresolved. A failed autofocus triggered inside a capture run does not stop that run. Channels I (TCP 4700) and W (TCP 4702, forwarded onto 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. APK 3.3.2 consumes it (route-based scenery/moon/sun/planet handling).

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AutoFocus"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Union. F: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Direct producer: start, working, complete, fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if stage string non-empty | - | Only when the detail holds a non-empty stage string; value set unresolved. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds (signed 32-bit low bits): current monotonic time minus start while working or started-but-unfinished, otherwise end minus start. Independent of Timestamp. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Stored error code; present at fail even when zero. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-ancestry names at send time (for example View, Stack); may be absent. Not an address. [READ] |
| `center_xy` | array<integer> | no | - | Focus centre, two integers in display/image pixels (conversion-specific). Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |
| `result` | any | if direct callback progress/result | - | Direct callback data embedded as JSON (object or array), not a quoted string. Nesting varies by callback. [READ] |
| `position` | integer | if legacy position branch | - | Focuser position, when the legacy branch appends it. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - F progress (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AutoFocus","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":3100,"center_xy":[960,540],"route":["View","Initialise"]}
```

Event, progress-curve - Direct V-curve progress (READ member names; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AutoFocus","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","result":{"curve":[0.01,-1.2,40.0],"points":[[1500,4.1],[1520,3.2]],"x_scale":[1400,1700],"y_scale":[1.5,4.5],"status_flag":2}}
```
